text: If you're wrapping up the evening outside, tonight's about as easy as it gets, clear skies settling in, a light northeast breeze, and lows dropping into the mid 50s. The lake's calm too, waves a foot or less and water still holding at 74, so if you're out near the water after sunset you'll want a light layer but nothing heavier. Tomorrow's the pick of the week: sunny start to finish, a high near 79, and winds staying light all day. The models nudge around a few degrees on that high but nobody's arguing about rain, this one's dry. Air quality's good too, so no worries there. Enjoy it while it lasts, because the weekend's bringing a dry slot Saturday before a wetter pattern tries to move in by Sunday. For tonight, no jacket needed, just maybe a light layer if you're lakeside past 8:30.
